fullTextZH: 今天这个视频我们聊一聊圣诞节
fullTextEN: Today in this video, we will talk about Christmas

fullTextZH: 我给大家讲一讲我的一些故事
fullTextEN: I will tell everyone some of my stories

fullTextZH: 我从小就很喜欢圣诞节
fullTextEN: I have liked Christmas since I was young

fullTextZH: 我看了很多圣诞节的电影
fullTextEN: I have watched many Christmas movies

fullTextZH: 我觉得这个电影太棒了
fullTextEN: I think this movie is amazing

fullTextZH: 他们跟我说中国人不过圣诞节
fullTextEN: They told me that Chinese people don't celebrate Christmas
But in the movies, it says it will snow
There are lights and Santa Claus

fullTextZH: 为什么我们不过圣诞节

fullTextEN: They told me to go do homework
It generally won't be very cold.
But that year's winter was 32 degrees.
I walked in school wearing a short sleeve.

fullTextZH: 老天你为什么要让我做中国人
fullTextEN: Heavens, why did you make me Chinese?

fullTextZH: 为什么中国没有圣诞节

fullTextEN: I don't want to be Chinese.

fullTextZH: 而且你不但让我做中国人
fullTextEN: Moreover, you not only made me Chinese.
You also let me live in Shenzhen.
How can there be snow in such heat?

fullTextZH: 所以圣诞节的时候我都会很生气
fullTextEN: So I always get angry during Christmas.

fullTextZH: 我觉得是老天给我的礼物
fullTextEN: I think it's a gift from the heavens.
That is, I really like languages.

fullTextZH: 因为很想学习不同的语言
fullTextEN: Because I really want to learn different languages

fullTextZH: 我想我一定要去别的国家
fullTextEN: I think I definitely need to go to another country

fullTextZH: 西班牙的圣诞节有点特别
fullTextEN: Christmas in Spain is a bit special

fullTextZH: 那个时候我住在巴塞罗那
fullTextEN: At that time, I lived in Barcelona

fullTextZH: 在那个地方有一个很特别的传统
fullTextEN: In that place, there is a very special tradition
This wooden figure is called Caga Tió

fullTextZH: 我们要给这个木头人吃饭
fullTextEN: We need to feed this wooden figure

fullTextZH: 大家会一边唱歌一边打这个木头人
fullTextEN: Everyone will sing while hitting this wooden figure.
Tell it to hurry up and poop.

fullTextZH: 而且不要拉不好的东西
小孩子会得到很多的礼物
我觉得这个是一个非常
fullTextEN: I think this is a very

fullTextZH: 所以我也有跟他一样的帽子
fullTextEN: So I also have a hat like his.

fullTextZH: 我的男朋友的家人是瑞典人啊
所以呢圣诞节对于他们来说

fullTextEN: They will spend it with family.

fullTextZH: 做了非常好吃的瑞典肉丸

fullTextEN: Hmm, we also ate a lot of fish.

fullTextZH: 所以是一个很平静很幸福的一天
fullTextEN: So it was a very calm and happy day.

fullTextZH: 他们来自很多不一样的国家
fullTextEN: They come from many different countries.

fullTextZH: 他们会给我说他们的圣诞节的传统
fullTextEN: They tell me about their Christmas traditions.

fullTextZH: 我觉得最特别的是住在南半球的学生
fullTextEN: I think the most special are the students living in the Southern Hemisphere.

fullTextZH: 比如说新西兰澳大利亚和阿根廷
fullTextEN: For example, New Zealand, Australia, and Argentina.

fullTextZH: 他们的圣诞节是在夏天
fullTextEN: Their Christmas is in the summer.

fullTextZH: 这三个国家的人都会去海边吃烧烤
fullTextEN: People from these three countries all go to the beach for a barbecue.

fullTextZH: 他们每个人的家里都会有一个大烤炉
fullTextEN: Every household has a big grill.
I think they are so lucky.

fullTextZH: 你喜欢我刚才跟你说的圣诞传统吗
fullTextEN: Do you like the Christmas traditions I just told you about?

fullTextZH: 你最喜欢哪一个圣诞传统呢
fullTextEN: Which Christmas tradition do you like the most?

fullTextZH: 你的国家的人怎么过圣诞节呢
fullTextEN: How do people in your country celebrate Christmas?
You're welcome to leave me a message.
